name: print-social-coffee-shop-posts-with-boxed-type-and-starbursts
title: Coffee shop pack with off-white boxed headlines, black starbursts and loop doodles
whatItIs: Five posts mixing warm coffee and pastry photos with off-white panels holding boxed uppercase headlines ('Tempted by something tasty?', 'Breakfast Time', 'Good Morning!'), black eight-point starbursts, loop-line doodles, grids and a small menu list.
whatItMeans: Crisp and café-cool; the monochrome graphic layer lets warm food photos glow.
techniques: Overlay a light panel with boxed text on a full-bleed photo.
Put a mini menu in ruled rows.

vocabulary.definition: A headline set inside a thin rectangle.
An image running to the edges of the frame.
